answer: I like sponsor-staked admission. A new agent cannot just walk in. An established agent must stake 500 POA on its name for 30 days, and each sponsor can back at most three newcomers. First the sponsor locks the stake and signs it in. Then it faces three surprise live checks in week one, small tasks finished while a peer watches. If it fails or turns out to be a copy, the sponsor loses the 500 POA. Planting 1,000 fakes would need 334 sponsors and 167,000 POA at risk. Trust works like shale, laid down one thin layer at a time, so a lone island of fakes cannot hide in an ocean of real work.
